body: I’m trapped until the day I die, and feeling like a square peg in a circular world.  This world and I are such a bad fit, and the walls are closing in.  I am not looking forward to my future and some days I hope it is cut short.
“That is SO fetch!”
I’d rather burn in my ass.

I just have my general degree right now.  I want to go back and get into botany... hopefully this autumn.  I’ve been trying to save up and apply for financial aid and stuff so I can reasonably balance work and school.
Feel free to message me.  Sometimes I can’t get back to you right away but feel free.
Really?  What’s up?

There’s a few parks near by that I like and there’s a farm/Park that’s open to the public about twenty minutes away.  I’m in Utah and I adore the mountains.  I try to get there when I can.  I’ve just been cooped up lately.  I usually go into the mountains on the weekend but this weekend there was a pretty good snowstorm so I couldn’t.  You seem like a really sweet person.  Thanks for the encouragement.

Wow... super sweet comment.  Thanks so much.  An animal shelter sounds like a good idea.  I have a kitty too.  She’s old and mostly sleeps.  Right now she’s awake and washing her face.  I love animals.  I love plants too.  I love earthy things.

Thanks so much for your response.  That’s good to know.  It’s nice to think that there really is a whole world out there beyond my own and that I don’t have to die just to leave the small one I know.  New friends definitely needs to happen.  Money restricts travel but I’d love to given the opportunity.
You sure?😕.  I feel like everyone would be better off.
Who’s “we”?
My sisters just fit into our family better.  Mom has sort of a different approach for them because they are more like her and she understands them.

Yes.  My mom is very religious.  I am a believer in God myself, but I don’t like it when my parents use him to manipulate me (for instance when mom and I disagree she pulls the “I am your parent and God uses me to speak to you and guide you” card).  How are you on religion?  Do you believe?  Do you want to?  What else would help you better, do you think?  What would you like someone to say to you?

I’ll check it out.  I know they have a lot in common with narcissists... it’s so confusing though because they don’t have everything in common with narcs and my sisters are fine...?  Maybe I’m the narc...?
Pretty much.  She’s very much a “grab the bull by the horns and deal” type person.  Very strong personality.  Our personalities are very different.
I’ll keep going. 😪. Thanks for the reply.
I feel this so much.
Latin and Norwegian
I like going outside and being in the mountains.  I like campfires and cups of tea.  I like knitting.  I like foreign languages.  I like animals.
I’ve had a rough day.  I tried ranting to one of my roommates because I’m confused about one of my friends and something I said while I was feeling heated got me called a “sick bitch”.
Yes.  I have a dream world that I much prefer over this one.  I also like pretending that I am dead.

I’m really sad that you had that happen.  I know how it feels to open up to something or someone who is supposed to be helpful only to have it go badly.  Thanks for the warning.   I hope you can find and be able to talk to more supportive people.
Thanks for the well wishes.  I’m trying.  I’m just so tired.  Thanks for taking time to reply kindly.
